verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow orchestration platform, so a library of starter workflow templates is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no public template library or gallery. The docs describe Temporal as Workflows-as-Code rather than a no-code engine, and the only nearby items are a getting-started walkthrough and a mention of viewing 'sample workflows' in the local Web UI. Neither is a documented, reusable template library for ops users.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
